Breeding trials, from line to recommendation

The seven synthetic UC4 files the SME sent on 29 Sep 2026, including the pre-configured trial recommendations: which lines, where they were tested, what the recommendation says, the rule that reproduces it, and whether the evidence traces back.

150 lines72 trials 6 sites2024 to 2026 72 trial verdicts synthetic, read-only
SourcesRuleGenomics ReconciliationLabOperations ChecksAppendix

Inferred, not supplied. The recommendation file states outcomes and a rule version, not thresholds. The cut-points on this page are the simplest fixed values that reproduce every outcome. Confirm them with the UC4 expert before presenting them as the rule. The v1 (kickoff) profile is kept in v1/report_v1.html.

Key findings

  • The scoring logic now ships as outcomes, not thresholds. trial_recommendations_synthetic.csv gives one verdict per trial (PASS 7, HOLD 35, FAIL 30) with a text rationale and RULE_VERSION = SYNTH_V1, but no cut-points.
  • Fixed thresholds reproduce every verdict (72 of 72): FAIL if yield < 7 t/ha or disease > 7; PASS if yield ≥ 9, moisture ≤ 22%, disease ≤ 5, GBV mean ≥ ~102 and resistant materials ≥ 50%; otherwise HOLD. The comparison basis is a fixed target, not a check variety or trial mean.
  • The rationale text hides one criterion. 4 of 11 trials whose rationale says all four criteria are met are HOLD, held back by the resistant-material share the text never mentions.
  • The grain changed from line to trial. Observations now carry no values: they only link 4 to 5 trials to each line. The pedigree, breeding stage and ADVANCEMENT_DECISION of v1 are gone.
  • Trial aggregates do not follow the recorded links. The GBV mean differs from the observation-linked lines in 72 of 72 trials; a block-of-10 mapping by line ID reproduces all of them.
  • Operations ignore the trial calendar. 144 of 216 operations fall outside their trial's start year; all are dated April to September 2026. Lab results (all 150 lines) have no dates or trait names.

Scoring

The trial recommendation and its rule

Each of the 72 trials carries a PASS, HOLD or FAIL, the trial-level values behind it and a rationale naming four criteria. Two knockouts (low yield, high disease) decide FAIL; five criteria together decide PASS. The cut-points are inferred: the file brackets them but does not state them.

Sources

Genomics

New in v2: one genotyped sample per line with four marker calls, a genomic breeding value and QC. The trial file summarises these per trial.

Sources

Do the trial aggregates trace back to lines?

A breeder asking why a trial failed will want the lines behind it. The genomics aggregates can be rebuilt, but only from a mapping the files never record. The field aggregates (yield, moisture, disease, height, flowering) have no line-level source at all, because v2 observations carry no values.

Sources

Lab tests

Lab results attach to a line, not a trial. Every line now has two or three, but names, units and dates are missing and the recommendation does not use them.

Sources

Field operations

Planting, irrigation and harvest only, with no quantities. The dates do not follow the trials they belong to.

Scoring

How tightly the data pins each cut-point

Each threshold lies somewhere in its bracket: the lower bound is the value closest to the line on one side, the upper bound on the other. used is the value this profile applies. Plant height, days to flowering and genomics QC never change an outcome.

Validation

Consistency checks

Operation rules test the record against the trial calendar and the extract (26 Sep 2026 12:00). Link and recommendation rules test whether trial-level values trace back to the lines the files connect to the trial. For the demo, the assistant should surface these as reasons for amber, not hide them.
